run_sampling_pipeline: run a Ray-based sampling pipeline to sample items from clustered embeddings using kmeans or hdbscan cluster labels
run_remotely_sample_clusters: run a remote Ray task that samples diverse items from clusters based on centroid distance or random selection
select_sample_ids_from_cluster: select diverse sample IDs from a cluster group using farthest-point sampling or random selection within the cluster
sample_with_equal_allocation: sample items with equal samples per cluster by randomly distributing sample size across all cluster labels
sample_with_sqrt_allocation: sample items with sqrt-proportional allocation per cluster ensuring at least one sample from each cluster
